description: Grams of flour, water, salt and yeast for any number of pizzas, by bakers' percentages. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

ballWeight.description: Weight of each dough ball in grams. About 250 for a 30 cm Neapolitan pizza, 280 for New York, 450 for a pan pizza.

balls.description: How many dough balls (one per pizza).

hydration.description: Water as a percentage of the flour weight (bakers' percentage), e.g. 62 for 62%.

oil.description: Olive oil, percent of flour weight. 0 if none.

salt.description: Salt, percent of flour weight, e.g. 2.8.

style.description: Optional starting point that fills any field you leave out: neapolitan (250 g, 62% water, 2.8% salt, no oil or sugar), new-york (280 g, 63%, 2% salt, 2% oil, 1% sugar), pan for Detroit/pan pizza (450 g, 72%, 2% salt, 2% oil). Fields you give win.

sugar.description: Sugar, percent of flour weight. 0 if none.

yeast.description: Yeast, percent of flour weight, in the chosen yeastType. If left out: the style's amount, or 0.3% instant. Equivalents by weight: active dry ≈ 1.25 × instant, fresh ≈ 3 × instant.

yeastType.description: instant dry, active dry, or fresh (compressed/cake) yeast.
